title: Description: When an iRule that processes client traffic using the DNS::scrape command is configured on a virtual…
description: A vulnerability exists in BIG-IP systems when an iRule using the DNS::scrape command is configured on a virtual server. Undisclosed requests can cause the Traffic Management Microkernel (TMM) to terminate, resulting in service disruption and potential remote code execution. This issue affects the data plane only and does not expose the control plane. The vulnerability allows a remote, unauthenticated attacker to cause denial-of-service (DoS) and possibly execute arbitrary code remotely.
